record.notes: A LowEndTalk thread cites USD 44.44 a year for 8 GB / 4 vCPU / 80 GB / 40 TB, which would be USD 3.70 a month. The vendor's own specials page carries twenty 8 GB SKUs at USD 39.99 to USD 75.00 a year, including three at USD 39.99 (USD 3.33 a month) and four at USD 44.44. Every single one reads '0 Available', and a product page returns an explicit 'Out of Stock ... orders for it have been suspended until more stock is available'. So the prices are real, published and unusable. VERDICT: 'paid-only' rather than a qualification, because a row that cannot be bought is not an offer — the DediRock lesson applied one step further. Worst case exposure is moot while nothing can be bought. Worth re-checking: these are restocked periodically, and the shapes are the best in the band if they return.
